Creating models

```{r, params, include=T, eval=T, results=F, message=F, warning=F}

# equilibrium models
Ns <- paste(paste(c(2.5e+4, 1e+5)), ";", sep="")
Ts <- paste(0, ";", sep="")

uL <- 1.25e-8
uR <- 1.25e-8

r <- 1e-8
s <- -c(5e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4)

params <- setDT(crossing(Ns, Ts, r, s, uL, uR))
n_models <- nrow(params)
fwrite(params, "params.csv")
```


```{bash dirs, engine.opts='-i', include=F, eval=T, results='hide', warning=F}

source ~/.bashrc

rm -rf model_*

n=$(cat params.csv | tail -n +2 | wc -l)
for (( i = 1; i <= $n; i++ )); do mkdir model_$i; done
```


```{r, demes, include=F, eval=T, results='hide', message=F, warning=F}

params <- fread("params.csv")
n_models <- nrow(params)

options(digits=16)
for(i in 1:n_models) {
  
  if(i %% 10000 == 0) {
    print(Sys.time())
    cat(paste(i, "\n"))
  }
  
  Ns <- as.numeric(strsplit(params[i,]$Ns, ";")[[1]])
  Ts <- as.integer(strsplit(params[i,]$Ts, ";")[[1]])
  u <- as.numeric(params[i,]$uL)
  r <- as.numeric(params[i,]$r)
  s <- as.numeric(params[i,]$s)
  
  sink(paste("model_", i, "/", "model_", i, ".yaml", sep=""))
  
  cat("time_units: generations\n")
  cat("demes:\n")
  cat("  - name: X\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  for(j in length(Ts):1) {
    cat("      - end_time: ")
    cat(format(Ts[j], scientific=F))
    cat("\n")
    cat("        start_size: ")
    cat(format(Ns[j], scientific=F))
    cat("\n")
  }
  cat("metadata:\n")
  cat("  - name: mutation\n")
  cat("    left_factor: 1\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(u)
  cat("]\n")
  cat("  - name: recombination\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(r)
  cat("]\n")
  cat("  - name: selection\n")
  cat("    start_time: .inf\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(format(s, scientific=F))
  cat("]\n")
  
  sink()
}
```

Testing steady-state stability for eigen/power methods,
different O(1-2p) and numerical precision (digits -> 16:double, 32:mpreal)

Log files have further details.

NOTE: ATM the eigenvalue decomposition is done with base Eigen 3.4, not Spectra

The following code was run from the command line (run_mpp_parallel.sh):

```{bash moments++, engine.opts='-i', include=T, eval=T, results='hide', warning=F}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
[[ -f ~/.bashrc ]] && source ~/.bashrc
set -euo pipefail

# Generate job list: one line per (order, model, P)
generate_jobs() {
  local n=$(tail -n +2 params.csv | wc -l)
  for (( o=50; o<=1000; o+=50 )); do # parallelize over Order first to optimize time
    for (( i=1; i<=n; i++ )); do
      echo "$o $i 16" # double (16-digit) precision
      echo "$o $i 32" # mpreal (32-digit) precision
    done
  done
}

# Worker function: runs a single momentspp job
run_job() {
  local o="$1"
  local m="$2"
  local p="$3"
  (
    cd "model_${m}"
    momentspp param=../opt.bpp F="model_${m}.yaml" O="$o" V=1 P="$p" NT=1 > "log_O_${o}_P${p}.txt"
    echo "done: Order $o, model $m, P=$p"
  )
}

export -f run_job

# Launch jobs with Order-first priority and max 16 parallel jobs
generate_jobs | sort -k1,1n -k2,2n | xargs -n 3 -P 16 bash -c 'run_job "$@"' _
```
